name: Italian Visura
description: Italian company or cadastral record (visura camerale / catastale). Detects Partita IVA, Codice Fiscale, REA number, cadastral references (Foglio / Particella / Subalterno), IBAN, Italian dates and phone numbers, plus names and addresses. Amounts kept visible.

patterns.name: Partita IVA
patterns.description: Italian VAT number: 11 digits, optional 'IT' prefix.

patterns.name: Codice Fiscale
patterns.description: Italian tax code: 16 uppercase letters and digits (case-sensitive).

patterns.name: Numero REA
patterns.description: Economic and Administrative Index number: province code + 5-7 digits, matched with its REA label.

patterns.name: Catasto
patterns.description: Cadastral reference: foglio, particella, mappale or subalterno with its number.

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number, with or without spaces between groups.

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: Italian date: DD/MM/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY.

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: Italian phone number: landline (0xx) or mobile (3xx), optional +39, not inside longer numbers.
